description: The 6 May MRC public meeting is evidenced, but there is no attendance count or reliable qualitative proof of at least 50 simultaneous participants.

description: The 22 May Cury sit-in is evidenced, but no source reports how many health workers sat in front of the emergency centre; the ≥50 threshold remains unresolved.
required_followup: Search permitted contemporaneous coverage or a direct union account for the Cury gathering’s simultaneous attendance; do not infer from workforce totals or the nationwide strike call.

description: The health strike call began 22 May; a public Cury sit-in is documented that day, with a June 5 public Ministry action later reported. The first qualifying gathering of ≥50 and episode onset remain unresolved.
required_followup: Compare the May 22 Cury assembly and June 5 Ministry action for participant group, demands, whether the same continuous strike episode, and any earlier/later public gatherings.
